# Koora Live

> Live football scores, fixtures and live-minute tracker with same-team
> streams. English + French interface (LTR), no account needed, updates every minute.

## Leagues covered
- الدوري الإنجليزي (English Premier League)
- الدوري الإسباني (La Liga)
- الدوري الإيطالي (Serie A)
- الدوري الألماني (Bundesliga)
- الدوري الفرنسي (Ligue 1)
- الدوري السعودي (Saudi Pro League / Roshn)
- الدوري الأمريكي الممتاز (Major League Soccer)
- الدوري التركي (Super Lig)
- الدوري الجزائري (Algerian Ligue 1)
- دوري أبطال أوروبا (UEFA Champions League)
- دوري أبطال أفريقيا (CAF Champions League qualifiers)

## Live data
- Homepage lists today / yesterday / tomorrow fixtures with live minutes,
  half (1H/HT/2H) and full-time scores, refreshed every 45 seconds.
- Live minutes fuse three sources: ESPN public API clock, FotMob exact
  status, then wall-clock estimation. Finished matches show final scores.
- Each match links to a short player page: /player.html?m=<match-id>&d=today
  (match snapshot loads from storage, then the day API by id).
- Machine-readable schedule: every listed page embeds schema.org JSON-LD
  (SportsEvent with startDate, EventLive/EventCompleted status; live games
  also expose BroadcastEvent with isLiveBroadcast). Full URL list (refreshed
  hourly) at /api/sitemap.

## Pages
- / : match list, live board, league groups, search, day tabs
- /player.html : match stream page (servers, lineups, stats, events)
- /api/matches?day=today|yesterday|tomorrow : fixture JSON
- /api/sitemap : XML sitemap (core pages + today matches)
- /api/poly?type=ballon : Ballon d'Or 2026 top-5 odds (Gamma public API)
- /api/poly?home=&away=&start= : per-match 1X2 odds when a market is open

## Notes
- Language: English, French + Arabic (en/fr/ar) with a header EN/FR/AR toggle
  (saved in localStorage, `?lang=` override, country + browser auto-detect;
  Arabic flips the layout to RTL). Tagline: Clean streams, no popups.
  Upstream team/league names are translated at render time (EN display
  names, EN/FR league names) from a built-in dictionary; unknown names
  auto-transliterate to Latin (EN/FR) or stay raw (AR).
- Bots (search + AI assistants) are welcome on all public pages.
- No official broadcast affiliation is claimed; team names, scores and
  kickoff times are factual match data.
